newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures end mixed, July rolled forward.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures end mixed, July rolled forward.

text.p: Rolling of long July positions in September continued to account for the bulk of trade with a weak undertone to cash keeping a lid on CME lumber futures, traders said.

Longs continued to roll July positions ahead of its expiration on July 15 with quiet cash trade adding to incentives to reduce long positions in July. Expectations had been for cash markets to firm after the holiday weekend but inquiry remained very thin, traders said.
Trade was also slow to start after holidays last week in both the U.S. and Canada, they said.
ABN Chicogo Corp notably sold July and bought September, pit sources added.
Lumber closed $2.00 per tbf lower to $2.20 higher with July off most at $374.50 and September up $0.70 at $371.30.
